name: Courser
body:
The courser is a mounted warrior spurring their steed to ride down their enemies and to ride to the defense of their allies.

Courser’s Mount (Ex)

The courser gains the service of a particularly powerful steed. They gain mount as per the cavalier ability. Additionally, they gain Mounted Combat as a bonus feat and a bonus to their Ride checks while mounted on their mount equal to 1/2 their vanguard levels (minimum +1).

This ability replaces valorous deflection.

Tactics of the Courser (Ex)

At 2nd level, the courser gains Ride-by-Attack and Spirited Charge as bonus feats. At 7th level, the courier gains Trample as a bonus feat. At 12th level, the courser gains a bonus to the overrun attempts made for the Trample feat equal to 1/2 their class levels and they may make a single attack with their equipped weapon in addition to their mount’s hoof attack.

This ability replaces weapons of the guardian.

Armored Charger (Ex)

At 3rd level, the courser no longer suffers armor check penalties on Ride checks.

His mount’s speed is not reduced when carrying a medium load or wearing medium barding.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 3rd level.

Defend Them (Ex)

At 3rd level, the courser may spur their mount to defend an ally. This ability operates as the behind me ability except that the courser may make a move as an immediate action to get themselves within 5 feet of their charge prior to enacting the ability. To do so, the courser must make a Ride check with a DC equal to 1/2 the feet of movement required, up to the mount’s double move distance. However, any movement used in this ability is deducted from the mount’s movement in the courser’s next turn. This ability modifies behind me.

Active Defense (Ex)

At 6th level, the courser may choose to apply their active defense ability to themselves or their mount, chosen at the time the Mettle is spent. This ability modifies active defense.

Maneuverable Mount (Ex)

At 7th level, the courser’s mount is considered one size smaller for movement and squeezing purposes. This does not reduce the size of the 9 mount to a size smaller than the courser and does not apply bonuses or penalties of the new size.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 7th level.

Powerful Charge (Ex)

At 7th level, when the courser makes a mounted charge, they may increase the charge damage multiplier by 1. This ability stacks with the Spirited Charge feat.

This ability replaces press the advantage.

Relentless Steed (Ex)

At 11th level, a courser’s mount does not reduce its speed when wearing heavy barding or carrying a heavy load. The courser may also expend a point of Mettle to reroll a Ride skill check or a saving throw made by the mount once per day, but must use the second roll even if it is worse.

This ability replaces the armor training at 11th level.

Break the Line (Ex)

At 12th level, when the courser makes a mounted charge, they may also make a bull rush attempt on all creatures in the line of the charge.

The bull rush moves the creatures 5 feet to either side of the charge, however, the creature may choose to which side they are moved. If the bull rush attempt fails, the charge ends. However if the courser has moved at least 10 feet on their mount, they may make a charge attack on the creature that blocked the charge. These bull rush attempts gain a bonus equal to the number of squares (or +1 per 5 feet) of the charge. Additionally, if the target of the charge is in the line of the charge, the courser may make a trample attempt along with the normal charge attack.

This ability replaces improved press the advantage.

Implacable Charger (Ex)

At 14th level, the courser’s mount is no longer slowed or prevented from charging by difficult terrain, whether natural, magical, or magically augmented. As long as the courser has a point of Mettle remaining, the mount is not slowed by effects that reduce speed and are immune to the daze and stunned conditions. Additionally, the courser is able to stay in the saddle even when stunned or paralyzed as long as they have one point of Mettle remaining.

This ability replaces implacable.

Ride Them Down (Ex)

At 15th level, a courser can spur his mount on while readying an attack. If a courser’s mount takes a single move, the courser can make a full-attack, taking his attacks at any point during his mount’s movement. Additionally, they may use the Trample feat to substitute an overrun attempt for any of the attacks. This movement provokes attacks of opportunity on the courser but not their mount.

However, the courser may expend a point of Mettle to negate the attack of opportunity.

This ability replaces the armor training gained at 15th level.
